assets.name: category-nature
assets.prompt: Create one production-ready isolated transparent PNG game UI icon, not a screenshot. Art reference image 1 is an approved cream/sage Q版 game HUD. Match its exact cute softly sculpted 2.5D matte clay visual language, plump rounded silhouettes, tidy hand-painted finish, upper-left soft lighting, no sharp outlines, refined gentle highlights, forest green/soft sage/cream with restrained vivid accents. One centered icon fills about 85% of the canvas, generous 7% clear padding all around, all edges and small pieces within frame. Truly transparent alpha background including canvas corners; NO fake checkerboard, no solid background, no surrounding medallion or panel, no shadow cast onto a backdrop (only subtle contact shading within the object), no text, no digits, no arrows, no dots, no badges, no watermark. Output square high resolution suitable for downscaling to a crisp 70px game icon. This is an independent cutout asset to assemble with live HTML controls. Extract and faithfully recreate ONLY the central nature-category sculpted symbol from reference 1: chunky rounded green mountain peaks and little green bushes, curling turquoise wave across the base, fluffy ivory storm cloud at upper right and one small golden lightning bolt. Keep the rounded triangular compact silhouette and pleasing green/blue/cream balance. Do not include the ivory circular dial, label or arrows.
